CREATE VIEW [STAR].[DIM_Orders] AS
SELECT
	T1.[SATZ_ID],
	T1.[DAT_VON_HIST],
	T1.[DAT_BIS_HIST],
	T1.[CustomerID],
	T1.[EmployeeID],
	T1.[OrderDate],
	T1.[RequiredDate],
	T1.[ShippedDate],
	T1.[ShipVia],
	T1.[Freight],
	T1.[ShipName],
	T1.[ShipAddress],
	T1.[ShipCity],
	T1.[ShipRegion],
	T1.[ShipPostalCode],
	T1.[ShipCountry],
	T1.[OrderID]
FROM
	[DWH].[DIM_Orders] T1
